Class AbstractWindowListener

java.lang.Object
com.wualabs.qtsurfer.engine.strategy.AbstractWindowListener
All Implemented Interfaces:
OnChangeRTIndicator.OnChangeListener, WindowTimeRTIndicator.WindowAwareListener
public abstract class AbstractWindowListener extends Object implements WindowTimeRTIndicator.WindowAwareListener
Base class for the listeners a strategy hangs off a window: it reacts when the window closes rather than on every tick, with strategy sugar methods on top. Holds references to the parent strategy and instrument so listeners can emit signals without verbose boilerplate.

It implements .OnChangeListener OnChangeListener, so it also works on a plain indicator — but the window context below is what it exists for.

Subclasses implement the listener contract as it is — onChange(StateStore store, double prev, double actual) — and use store directly. There is no init ritual and no store field: the store is event data, handed in with the values it belongs to. Outside an event the same store is reachable as indicators.getStateStore(), which is also what resolves it — so asking for it there is what creates it.

When registered on a window, the window binds itself here, so getPrevInstant()/getCurrInstant() report the boundaries of the window that is firing.

    • setWindow

      public final void setWindow(WindowTimeRTIndicator window)
      Bound by the window when this listener is registered on it — not something a strategy calls. One instance may only serve one window: sharing it would make the boundaries below report whichever window fired last, so a second binding fails instead.
      Specified by:
      setWindow in interface WindowTimeRTIndicator.WindowAwareListener
      Parameters:
      window - the window that will notify this listener
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if this listener is already registered on a different window

    • getEngineVersion

      protected final String getEngineVersion()
      The engine version this listener is running on (e.g. "0.99.55"), or "unknown" if it cannot be determined — the same sugar AbstractStrategy.getEngineVersion() gives a strategy, repeated here (with its components below) because a listener is where most strategy logic lives and it does not inherit from the strategy.
      Returns:
      the running engine version

    • getEngineVersionMajor

      protected final int getEngineVersionMajor()
      The major component of getEngineVersion() — the 0 of "0.99.55".
      Returns:
      the major component, or EngineVersion.UNKNOWN_COMPONENT (-1) if the version cannot be parsed — negative so a gate such as getEngineVersionMajor() >= 1 fails closed rather than matching by accident
